cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(sdjni CXX C)
set(SD_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SD_WEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SD_WEBM OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_OPENMP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GGML_LLAMAFILE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${SD_DIR} sd)
get_target_property(SD_SRCS stable-diffusion SOURCES)
list(FILTER SD_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "tokenizers/vocab/vocab\\.cpp$")
list(APPEND SD_SRCS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vocab_slim.cpp)
set_property(TARGET stable-diffusion PROPERTY SOURCES ${SD_SRCS})
target_include_directories(stable-diffusion PRIVATE ${SD_DIR}/src/tokenizers/vocab)
add_library(sdjni SHARED sd_jni.cpp)
target_include_directories(sdjni PRIVATE ${SD_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(sdjni PRIVATE stable-diffusion log -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL)
